biotools.summary: A Nextflow Pipeline for Eukaryotic Gene Prediction and Functional Annotation GeneForge is a high-throughput Nextflow pipeline designed for the comprehensive structural and functional annotation of eukaryotic genomes. It orchestrates the parallel execution of BRAKER3 and FunAnnotate, evaluates their performance using BUSCO, and provides a unified functional annotation suite.
biotools.name: GeneForge
